stem.en: Two copper wires have the same length but one has twice the cross-sectional area of the other. How do their resistances compare?
stem.et: Kahel vasktraadil on sama pikkus, kuid ühel on kaks korda suurem ristlõikepindala kui teisel. Kuidas on nende takistused omavahel seotud?

label.en: The thicker wire has half the resistance, since resistance is inversely proportional to area
label.et: Paksemal traadil on pool takistust, sest takistus on pöördvõrdeline pindalaga

label.en: The thicker wire has twice the resistance, since it contains more metal
label.et: Paksemal traadil on kaks korda suurem takistus, sest selles on rohkem metalli

label.en: Both have identical resistance, since they are made of the same material
label.et: Mõlemal on identne takistus, sest need on samast materjalist

label.en: Resistance cannot be compared without knowing the resistivity value
label.et: Takistusi ei saa võrrelda, teadmata eritakistuse väärtust
